learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge, understanding, and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.
Knowledge and abilities for the calculation, design, and testing of machines.
Knowledge and abilities for the application of materials engineering.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology, and quality control.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Evaluate, critically and constructively, the advantages and opportunities of different solutions to the same problem.
Develop professional texts or scientific-technical reports according to the conventions of the discipline.
Solve complex problems autonomously within the discipline.
Draw conclusions from practical or experimental work and research carried out autonomously.

teaching_methods: Resolution of cases (individual or in group)
Project work (planning, design, and execution of activities)
Group preparation of essays, problem-solving, projects
Individual study (reading, exam preparation, exercise elaboration, class preparation)
In-person classes to review fundamental concepts and doubts
Exercise resolution in class or via Teams
assessment_rules: The final grade is obtained by weighting written tests (60%), practical reports/problems (25%), and the Integrated Project (15%). A minimum average score of 4 in the written tests is required to average with the other components. The course is passed if the final grade is 5 or higher and no individual component grade is below 4. Unauthorized AI use will be considered plagiarism or academic fraud, potentially resulting in a 0 for the instrument or failure of the course.
